entries.def:
ὑγρός, -ά, -όν, 
[in LXX: Jdg.16.7,8 (לַח), Job.8.16 (רָשׂב), Sir.39.13 
wet, moist, opposite to ξηρός: of wood, sappy, green: Luk.23.31.†
(AS)

ὑδρία, -ας, ἠ
(ὕδωρ), [in LXX for בַּד ;] 
__1. prop., a water-pot or jar: Jhn.2.6, 7 Jhn.4.28.
__2. More frequently in Attic = ἄγγυς, a pot, urn or jar of any kind, as for holding wine, coins, etc. (see Rutherford, NPhr., 23; MM, xxv).
† (AS)

ὑδροποτίω, -ῶ
(ὕδωρ, πίνω), [in LXX: Dan LXX 1:12 שָׁתָה מַיִם) * ;] 
to drink water, opposite to οἴνῳ χρῆσθαι: 1Ti.5.23 (Hdt., i, 71; Plat., Rep., 561 with, al.).†
(AS)

ὑδρωπικός, -ή, -όν
(ὕδρωψ, dropsy), 
dropsical, suffering from dropsy: Luk.14.2.†
(AS)

ὕδωρ 
genitive, 
ὕδατος, τό, 
[in LXX chiefly for מַיִם ;] 
water: Mat.3.16, Mrk.1.10, Luk.7.44, Jhn.4.7, Jas.3.12, Rev.8.10, al.; pl., Mat.14.28-29, Jhn.3.23, Rev.1.15, al.; βαπτίζειν (ἐν) ὕδατι, Mat.3.11, Mrk.1.8, Jhn.1.26, al.; τ. λυυτρὸν τοῦ ὕ., Eph.5.26 opposite to οἴνος, Jhn.2.9; 4.46; αἷμα, Jhn.19.34, Heb.9.19, 1Jn.5.6 Jhn.5.8 Mat.17.15 Mrk.9.22; πνεῦμα, Jhn.1.26, 31; 1.33; πνεῦμα καὶ πῦρ, Mat.3.11,…

ὑετός, -οῦ, ὁ
(ὕω, to rain), [in LXX chiefly for ;] 
rain: Act.14.17; 28.2, Heb.6.7, Jas.5.18, Rev.11.6; ὄψιμος (which see), sc. ὑ., Jas.5.7.†
(AS)

υἱοθεσία, -ας, ἡ
(cf. the cl. phrases, υἱὸν τίθεσθαι, θετὸς υἱός), frequently in Inscr. (see Deiss., BS, 239), adoption of a son (or daughter); metaphorically, of God's relation established 
__(a) with Israel: Rom.9.4 
__(b) with Christ­ians: Rom.8.15, Gal.4.5, Eph.1.5; of its consummation, Rom.8.23.†
(AS)

ὕλη, -ης, ἡ 
[in LXX: Job.19.29 (†) Job.38.40 (סֻכָּה), Psa.69.2 B.l א (יָוֵן), Isa.10.17 (שָׁמִיר), Wis.11.17; 15.13, Sir.28.10, 2Ma.2.24, 4Ma.1.29 * ;] 
__1. wood, forest, woodland (Thus., Xen., al.). 
__2. wood, timber, fuel (Hom., Hdt., Thuc., al.): Jas.3.5 (see Hort, Ja., 70, 104 f.). 
__3. = Lat. materia, esp. in Philosophy, matter (Arist. and later writers; Wis, ll. with).†
(AS)

αὐτός, -ή, -ό, 
determinative pron., in late Gk. much more frequently than in cl. (WM, 178f.; Jannaris, HGG, §1399). 
__1. Emphatic (so always in nom. exc. when preceded by the art., see infr., iii); 
__(1) self (ipse), expressing opposition, distinction, exclusion, etc., αὐ. ἐκχυθήσεται, Luk.5.37 αὐ. ἐγινώσκεν, Jhn.2.25 αὐ.ὑμεῖς, Jhn.3.28 καὶ αὐ. ἐγώ, Rom.15.14 αὐ. Ἰησοῦς, Jhn.2.24 αὐ. καὶ οἱ μετ᾽ αὐτοῦ, Mrk.2.25…
